request.text: Compose original music for Crimson Thread Pilgrimage, a dark fairytale underground action-adventure. Natural acoustic instruments, expressive phrasing, clear voicing, transparent mix with space for gameplay sound effects. No imitation of existing music or named artists, no chiptune, EDM drops, trailer braams or mastering distortion. Shared original Silent Toll motif: D4 down to A3 then up to B-flat3, then a rest; leave it unresolved except in endings A and C. Crimson Thread countertheme: D4 leap to B-flat4, then A4 G4 F4 E4, in plucked timbres. Submerged D1 drone in three slowly interfering layers, reversed bronze swells separated by irregular eight-to-thirteen-second breaths, whole-tone C-D-E-F-sharp clusters and falling microtones. Almost nonmusical, no fixed beat. One fleeting very low-pass plucked Crimson Thread phrase beneath the surface, reverse the Silent Toll order. No cheap horror stingers or literal water effects. Strictly instrumental; NO vocals, humming, choir, lyrics, speech or narration. Finish with texture and harmony compatible with the opening, no big final cadence, leaving a three-second editable overlap for a smooth game loop.
